applicability: GET /api/notes/folder (list_folder and row helpers) over one master's notes root.
conditions: Every request opens and reads the live folder inside the call; no cache or module-level state.
exclusions: Browser-side caching or polling cadence in the dashboard client.
statement: The folder endpoint keeps no state between requests: every request opens and answers the live folder inside the call, so a note written or grown after one listing appears current in the next. (Dated L55 walk-from-root phrasing retired with the walk; the no-state guarantee is unchanged.)
